cause_quote: The ClawRouter manifest added `"chat": false` for `openai/gpt-6-luna`, which made the existing resolver reject the model before consulting the discovered route.
user_saw: Session observer assessments stopped when the configured utility model had a discovered chat grant and a typed-only static catalog entry.
summary: The shared model resolver now uses the chat capability captured at admission for the selected model and matching physical route, falling back to the static declaration when the captured capability is absent.
reasoning: I checked the parent of the ClawRouter Decisions commit and found that the observer already used utility completion, ClawRouter discovery already produced Responses routes, and Luna had no static chat denial. The Decisions commit added that denial, activating the resolver’s early rejection, and the later change that preserved explicit discovery grants left the admitted-catalog path subject to it. The earlier route is supported by source and retained-catalog test evidence, with no historical live observer run available to verify.
